summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.

Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/server_updates

src/agent_runtime/server_updates/init.py

Python · Tier A

Group controller-side Server update coordination, request admission and Settings API registration. coordinator binds owner-selected intent to controller RAM and the installation-private journal; admission fences new task/native/inference work; routes exposes public progress and maintenance controls. Package replacement and rollback remain in the independent bootstrap/runtime helper modules. Importing this package alone starts no worker or update.

src/agent_runtime/server_updates/admission.py

Python · Tier A

Fence task/native and non-task execution against an accepted Server update in the existing controller transaction. operation reads active intent, holds fences all execution, run_context discovers continuation ancestry, and guard_run/submission reject new execution with stable conflicts. The coordinator lock couples request registration to acceptance; these helpers neither wait for shutdown nor authorize package installation.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
submission 15 Wrap non-task request registration in the update coordinator lock and reject new unadmitted work while an operation holds execution. Existing services without an update/RAM owner retain their original call path.
operation 49 Read the active Server update from the coordinator's record view in the caller's hub transaction. Return None without an attached coordinator or active operation; no private journal I/O occurs in this admission helper.
holds 59 Hold all execution and continuations from acceptance until activation settles. Captured identities remain available to cancellation owners, but never authorize another launch.
run_context 65 Walk persisted continuation parents with a visited set and combine ancestor run IDs with the run's accepted task/request identities for the shared admission interface.
guard_run 84 Reject a native run mutation that crosses the current update fence using the stable server_updating LaneConflict code. Callers execute this within their existing repository transaction so admission and update acceptance observe the same publication.

src/agent_runtime/server_updates/coordinator.py

Python · Tier A

Coordinate owner-authorized compiled Server updates without replacing the process before durable state is saved. ServerUpdates owns release selection, admitted-work capture, transactional execution fences, checkpoint readiness and installation-journal reconciliation. Background discovery and supervision use separate lifecycles so helper recovery survives RAM shutdown. The independent installer prepares/replaces/rolls back packages; this coordinator records the final-save receipt and the returning boot readiness proof. Failures retain diagnostics and explicit retry/recovery gates.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
ServerUpdates 40 Coordinate owner-selected Server updates across controller RAM admission, a local installation journal and an independent installer. This owner drains admitted work and proves final persistence; the helper owns package preparation, process replacement and rollback. Imported database rows cannot substitute for local installation authorization.
ServerUpdates.__init__ 44 Bind services, installation facts, private journal and the independent Server release catalog. Register the coordinator on the hub/app, establish coordination locks and counters, then adopt interrupted preparation and reconcile local authorization before workers start.
ServerUpdates.adopt_interrupted_preparation 78 Recover a pre-activation operation whose original controller process identity no longer exists. Preserve a live controller/helper owner, reset interrupted save/preparation to an appropriate resumable stage and bind the new boot; never fabricate the previous boot's final- save receipt.
ServerUpdates.save_catalog 119 Publish a detached catalog/preview payload through the controller record transaction when persistence exists. Explicit callers request checkpoints where required; this helper alone does not authorize installation.
ServerUpdates.put 128 Write the indexed operation ID/status and full payload into the caller's existing transaction, keeping the queryable admission state aligned with its stored operation.
ServerUpdates.current 141 Prefer the installation journal, overlaying an in-memory final-save failure if the journal could not record it. Otherwise return the newest persisted operation while the hub is open; a closed hub is not read as a writable recovery source.
ServerUpdates.reconcile 157 Fail active imported/unbound operations that lack this installation's matching private journal, then mirror the journal into RAM only while bootstrapping or ready. Journal/helper supervision continues after durable close without writing into the closed hub.
ServerUpdates.source 201 Expose only the configured Server release repository, independently of the Gateway update source.
ServerUpdates.configure_source 207 Require controller persistence, validate/reset the catalog's repository and request a checkpoint for the changed discovery configuration. Accepted operation descriptors are stored separately and remain pinned.
ServerUpdates.check 217 Request an explicit catalog check, persist its resulting discovery state and return the current update/status projection. Catalog rate limits and fetch errors retain their own handling.
ServerUpdates.status 224 Combine installed build/platform/variant facts, the compatible catalog offer and public operation progress. Report separate catalog/custom-URL availability without exposing readiness tokens, private installation records or an authorization to replace the process.
ServerUpdates.preview 261 Validate a URL's companion descriptor against the installed platform/variant and save a custom selection bound to this instance and current build. Request persistence of the preview; package download and work fencing begin only after explicit acceptance.
ServerUpdates.work 307 Inspect task and native-reference views in the supplied hub transaction. Retain unfinished admitted tasks, active/input-wait/interrupted tasks, queued tasks with unfinished attempts and referenced native runs, including work without a remote Gateway. Return stable sorted blocker identities without interpreting a quiet UI as completion.
ServerUpdates.external_blockers 341 Collect active non-task requests, inference mutations/operations/jobs, prompt-cache comparisons and running exports from their owners. These observations complement transactional task/run blockers; the corresponding admission guards prevent new work from slipping into the drain boundary.
ServerUpdates.begin 398 Accept one exact selected release under the coordinator and installation locks. Reuse the same active selection, reject competing/stale/incompatible choices, and verify the registered installation has not changed. Atomically snapshot admitted task/run identities into RAM, record local journal authorization intent and request its checkpoint before an installer can start. Custom previews expire after one hour and are bound to instance/current build.
ServerUpdates.ready_timeout 518 Read the startup verification budget from SMTO_SERVER_UPDATE_READY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS. Missing or invalid integers use 600 seconds; nonpositive integers clamp to one. This is not a deadline for draining work or saving controller state.
ServerUpdates.get 528 Find an operation in the private journal or controller records, overlaying a recoverable save error for the current operation when needed. Raise HTTP 404 for an unknown ID; callers apply the public projection before HTTP delivery.
ServerUpdates.cancel 545 Under the coordinator lock, cancel only the same current operation in a cancellable preparation stage, then reconcile its journal result into RAM. Repeated cancellation is harmless; shutdown/activation stages reject cancellation rather than implying the old process is untouched.
ServerUpdates.retry 569 Retry stopping or final save within the accepted operation. A terminal preparation or activation failure revalidates the pinned selection and captures newly admitted work.
ServerUpdates.maintenance 594 Reserve a maintenance counter after rejecting an active update, releasing it in finally even if the protected action fails. Keeping the reservation across the whole action prevents update acceptance during an asynchronous maintenance request.
ServerUpdates.inference_admission 610 Serialize inference mutation admission with update acceptance, recovering a run's ancestor context when available. Stop-work updates reject execution immediately; stopping remains allowed. Count in-flight mutations until finally so the updater accounts for them before handoff.
ServerUpdates.start 633 Capture the running event loop and start one journal supervisor when persistence/journal exist. Start release discovery only for supported installations; construction and read-only status calls do not start these threads.
ServerUpdates.stop 646 Signal the supervisor, stop discovery and join the supervisor for the caller's bounded timeout. Durable operation/helper ownership survives thread shutdown in the private journal.
ServerUpdates.quiesce 654 Stop release-catalog writes with a bounded discovery join while leaving journal/helper supervision alive during final controller persistence and process replacement.
ServerUpdates.discover 664 Poll the catalog every minute, relying on its normal 15-minute interval/backoff to decide when network discovery is due. Persist results only before quiescence; log failures and continue on a later pass.
ServerUpdates.ensure_helper 677 Serialize helper recovery, reuse an acknowledged helper only when its full process identity still matches, and otherwise spawn through the bootstrap owner. Final controller shutdown requires this independent owner first.
ServerUpdates.run 695 Advance the durable operation every half second until stopped. Log coordination failures without terminating supervision or treating them as successful handoff.
ServerUpdates.advance 715 Reconcile authorization, refresh drain blockers and move to helper startup only when work clears. Require the requested checkpoint epoch/revision before writing package-bound authorization and spawning the installer. Supervise recoverable helpers at five-second intervals, retain the server on spawn failure, and schedule final shutdown only after preparation completes.
ServerUpdates.shutdown 840 First ensure an independent helper, then mark saving and ask the shutdown controller for a confirmed durable close. Only afterward record drained plus the matching saved-operation receipt. On failure keep retry controls available, including an in-memory error overlay if the journal volume also fails; no failure grants replacement authority.
ServerUpdates.activation_pending 880 Keep startup fenced while an active operation has a durable drain receipt or is restarting, verifying or rolling back, including rollback_failed. Terminal success/cancellation otherwise releases this activation gate.
ServerUpdates.publish_ready 895 Require inference management readiness and a matching registered running installation before journaling this boot's process, supervisor, build, variant and bundle identity. The independent helper still validates that proof before completing activation.
ServerUpdates.wait_activation 928 Wait asynchronously for the helper to settle activation, then reconcile its final journal state. The controller does not impose an additional timeout that could release the fence after failed rollback.

src/agent_runtime/server_updates/routes.py

Python · Tier A

Expose owner-facing Server update selection and progress through the existing Settings API. Strict request models bound repository/URL/selection inputs; register delegates discovery, preview, acceptance, cancellation and final-save retry to ServerUpdates. Public operation projections exclude private readiness and installation fields. MaintenanceMiddleware holds conflicting TLS/import/restart/purge writes across asynchronous requests; portal middleware continues to own authentication and CSRF.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
Selection 22 Accept one bounded, nonempty release-selection key and reject unknown fields; package identity is resolved and revalidated by the coordinator.
Source 29 Accept the bounded repository setting, including an empty value to disable discovery; repository syntax validation belongs to the release catalog.
Preview 36 Bound package and optional descriptor URL input sizes before metadata validation. This shape does not authorize downloading or installing the package.
register 45 Construct the coordinator and register Server update status, discovery, preview, acceptance and recovery endpoints plus maintenance middleware. Portal middleware owns authentication/CSRF; operation responses use allowlisted public projections.
register.status 61 Return the current public update/installation projection with no-store so browsers do not reuse stale activation or retry controls.
register.check 67 Run explicit release discovery and return its current status; this endpoint does not select or install an offered build.
register.discovery 71 Read a retained report page with no network discovery or installation side effects.
register.source 79 Return the independent Server discovery repository setting.
register.configure 85 Validate and persist a new Server release source through the coordinator, leaving any accepted package selection pinned.
register.preview 91 Read and validate package metadata, returning an instance/build-bound custom selection for later explicit acceptance.
register.begin 98 Accept a selected release and return HTTP 202 for the durable operation. The coordinator handles exact retries, compatibility, maintenance exclusions and admitted-work capture.
register.operation 104 Read one operation and remove private installation/readiness fields before returning it; unknown identities retain the coordinator's HTTP 404.
register.cancel 112 Request cancellation of the same accepted operation while its stage remains cancellable and return the public result.
register.retry 118 Schedule a failed final-save retry and return HTTP 202 without waiting for shutdown or installation completion.
maintenance 128 Reserve the app's update/maintenance exclusion when an owner exists, otherwise provide a no-op context for environments without Server update support.
MaintenanceMiddleware 134 Reserve maintenance admission across asynchronous request bodies and writes.
MaintenanceMiddleware.__call__ 144 Hold maintenance admission across the complete asynchronous body/response handling of mutating TLS, import, restart and runtime-purge requests. Read-only and unrelated routes pass through; HTTP admission conflicts become JSON responses. This middleware does not replace portal authentication or CSRF checks.
